Replay: GET the open-view URL to receive cookie CSRF_TOKEN; then POST https://analytics.momixpc.com/ZDBTableDataAction.ma?ZDBACTION=GENERATETABULARVIEW&OBJID=<report>&CONFIGASXML=true&OBJTYPE=Report&privatelink=<key>&CONOBJID=<dashboard>&FROMDASHBOARD=true&FROMNEWDASHBOARD=true&DASHEDITMODE=false&CONFIGID=<config>&SHOWVMFILTERS=false&APPLYDASHVMFILTERS=true&ENABLEALLUSERFILTERS=true&CHANGESLIDERBOUNDS=false&SUBREQUEST=XMLHTTP&_ZVER_=101 with headers X-ZCSRF-TOKEN: ZDB_CSRF_TOKEN=<cookie>, X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest, ZReports-Current-Org: 683495554, Content-type: text/xml and body <DBSVRequest><dcdet cinfo='false'><zrtlv cr='R TQUARTER,' dcr='x' aot='ABSDATECATEGORICAL' op='PF' st='100' lbl='Timeline Filter' isDashCr='true'/></dcdet><tvc cinfo='false' jt='1'><tvf></tvf></tvc></DBSVRequest>. Timeline tokens verified: 'R TMONTH,', 'R TQUARTER,', 'R TYEAR,' (Today/This Week exist in UI). Response JSON: reportColNameDetails, dataColOrder, dataText (rows), navigInfo [start,pageSize,total,...]. Max 200 rows per response; paging parameter not found. Map chart: POST ZAChartView.ve?CHARTVIEWACTION=CHARTVIEW&...&FIRSTTIMELOADING=true with <zadata> body returns lat/long (4 dp), status, start date, start time, reach waterbody, end date, municipality.
fields: CSO view: Report Type, Muncipality, Status, Date Activated, Event Start Time, CSO Group Name, Request ID, Receiving Waterbody, CSO Estimated Volume, How was estimated quantity or rate determined, Date Ceased, Event End Time, Total Rainfall, Final Volume, Describe how final volume was determined

SSO view: Reporting Utility, Status, Incident Type, Weather Conditions, Date Bypass Began or was Discovered, Event Start Time, Location of Bypass, Type of Bypass, Cause of Bypass, Cause of Bypass Other Explanation, How was Incident Discovered, Estimated Quantity or Rate of Discharge, How was estimated Quantity or Rate Determined, Reach Waterbody, Request ID, Waterbody Name, Date Bypass Ended, Event End Time, Final Quantity, How was Final Volume Determined, How incident was resolved, Municipality, Address
Map charts: Latitude, Longitude, Status, dates, Reach Waterbody, Municipality
fills_event_fields: event_type (CSO vs SSO view; Incident Type)
waterbody (free text; often null in 2026 CSO rows)
cannot_fill: outfall id for most 2026 CSO rows
revision_history (only latest state; 2 h vs 5-day reports appear as separate rows)
cadence: Operators must file within 2 h and update daily (CGS 22a-424a(c)(2)); rows appear as filed (QAlert -> Zoho sync latency not measured). 4,142 CSO rows and 2,275 SSO rows from 2021-12-01 to 2026-11-01; 2026 YTD: 723 CSO, 393 SSO; Q4 2026 to date: 45 CSO, 17 SSO.
history: 2021-12-01 onward in the dashboard; 2016-07 to 2021-11 in the AGOL archive layers; annual xlsx reports for 2021-2025.
license: No terms of use found on the dashboard; footer links 'Terms of Use | Privacy Statement' point to wilco.org (Williamson County TX) template pages - vendor boilerplate, not DEEP terms. Zoho Analytics page carries no licence.
status_reason: The only live statewide feed of CSO, SSO and permitted-bypass reports filed under CGS 22a-424a since 2021-12-01; replayable with plain HTTP (no login).
notes: Data caveats quoted from DEEP: 'Data quality, especially volumes, is not checked by DEEP.' 'Multiple notifications may be sent for the same discharge'. Status 'Open' is unreliable: 29 SSOs showed Open on 2026-11-01 including events from 2024-09-04 (East Windsor) and 2024-12 (Stonington). In 2026 rows, CSO Group Name and Receiving Waterbody are null for MDC, Norwich, Bridgeport West and GNH (only Bridgeport East populated) - a regression vs 2022-2025 rows. Times are free text with typos ("11:45 AM'", "10:30AM"). Some SSO rows have Reporting Utility 'null'. The dashboard calls itself 'Bypass / CSO Live Map' on the DEEP CSO page.
